The righteous shall be glad in Yahweh, and shall take refuge in him. All the upright in heart shall praise him!
Be glad in Yahweh, you righteous people! Give thanks to his holy Name.

translations.web: But let the righteous be glad. Let them rejoice before God. Yes, let them rejoice with gladness.
translations.bsb: But the righteous will be glad and rejoice before God; they will celebrate with joy.
translations.kjv: But let the righteous be glad; let them rejoice before God: yea, let them exceedingly rejoice.
translations.asv: But let the righteous be glad; let them exult before God: Yea, let them rejoice with gladness.
